Six Sigma Greenbelt or Blackbelt Certification

People who do well in this role are often quick to grasp the logic of aerospace quality systems and process controls.

Completes Quality Engineering assignments with minimal supervision.
Lead and/or provide technical advice and feedback to the Engineering & program management teams assigned to continuous improvement and problem solving.
Assure that product shipped meets internal and external customer requirements.
Lead corrective action process using 8D, 5 Why, A3, and lean tools.

Formulate and implement quality assurance procedures, policies, and standards. Ensure these documents align with the recognized Aerospace Quality System Standard as well as [Company name masked] Objectives, Policies and Procedures.
Communicate quality issues to front line leaders and factory personnel and lead root cause and permanent corrective action documentation.
Direct the disposition and analysis of returned material and internal non-conforming product. Ensure that actions around top pareto items are identified and completed.
Provide updates to customer and [Company name masked] program management & engineering.
Other duties as assigned
cond_0616.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Bachelor's degree from accredited institution.
5-10 Years' experience in an aerospace manufacturing environment.
Knowledge of assembly operations, gauging, and testing.
Ability to read and understand Blue Prints, Specifications, and Requirements
Experience in performing Quality Audit
Useable skills with MS Office software
Quality System Knowledge (e.g. AS9100, ISO 9001, TS16949)
Preferred Requirements
Six Sigma Greenbelt or Blackbelt Certification
ASQ Certified Quality Engineer (CQE) or Certified Quality Auditor (CQA)
Familiar with MIL-STD's and NASA requirements

You will work with operations, customers, and suppliers to support process improvements, cost control programs, and compliance with customer, industry, and internal specifications.
cond_0648.responsibilities:
Work with minimal supervision to complete Quality Engineering assignments.
Coordinate with Engineering and program management teams on continuous improvement and problem solving, providing technical advice and feedback.
Help ensure that product shipped meets internal and external customer requirements.
Coordinate corrective action processes using 8D, 5 Why, A3, and lean tools.
Serve as an organizational contact for customer concerns and work with relevant teams to ensure appropriate corrective actions are deployed.
Collaborate on formulating and implementing quality assurance procedures, policies, and standards. Ensure these documents align with the recognized Aerospace Quality System Standard as well as [Company name masked] Objectives, Policies and Procedures.
Share quality issues with front line leaders and factory personnel and coordinate root cause and permanent corrective action documentation.
Support the disposition and analysis of returned material and internal non-conforming product. Ensure that actions around top pareto items are identified and completed in coordination with relevant teams.
Provide updates to customers and [Company name masked] program management and engineering.
Other duties as assigned
cond_0648.requirements:
Bachelor's degree from accredited institution.
5-10 Years' experience in an aerospace manufacturing environment.
Knowledge of assembly operations, gauging, and testing.
Ability to read and understand Blue Prints, Specifications, and Requirements
Experience in performing Quality Audit
Useable skills with MS Office software
Six Sigma Greenbelt or Blackbelt Certification
ASQ Certified Quality Engineer (CQE) or Certified Quality Auditor (CQA)
Familiar with MIL-STD's and NASA requirements
Quality System Knowledge (e.g. AS9100, ISO 9001, TS16949)
